findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "hospitals" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resolve_hospital_mrf, list_hospitals_on_domain, verify_quote · Private data: resolve_hospital_mrf, list_hospitals_on_domain, verify_quote · Public sink: list_hospitals_on_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resolve_hospital_mrf, list_hospitals_on_domain, verify_quote · Private data: resolve_hospital_mrf, list_hospitals_on_domain, verify_quote · Public sink: list_hospitals_on_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
